concept.reason: Primary adult skull and parietal photographs available.

scope: Original whole-organism adult, strongly forward-curving nasal horn and paired long frill spikes.
specimen_basis: Adult holotype MOR456 8-9-6-1: Wilson & Scannella2021 Fig8B, McDonald2011 Fig7A. Do not use subadult Fig8A straight-horn phenotype.

scale.basis: NHM taxon-level6m estimate, NOT measured complete holotype skeleton.

diagnostic_targets: Large nasal horn curves strongly forward and downward, attached to snout; not a straight rhino spike.
Adult supraorbital ornament rounded low bosses, not long Triceratops brow horns.
One dominant long straight P3 spike each side of frill; remaining edge processes subordinate.
Heavy quadruped torso, four weight-bearing legs, beak and tapering tail; retain entire animal.
uncertainties: Body proportion and skin/colour/keratin outline inferred; no claim of a single complete articulated holotype body.
Living soft tissue covers cranial bone openings. Fossil breakage/assembly gaps must not become body holes.
Skull references compare different ontogenetic stages; adult phenotype only.
acceptance_checks: Curved nose horn visibly projects forward then downward in side view.
Two dominant frill spikes separated by negative space in front/top views.
Brow bosses low, four limbs connected, no detached horn/frill.
handoff_contract: Same localdir maker/QA. Maker COMPLETE fixedhash then stops. Root asynchronous backup, local-first integration; no maker upload or cleanup.
